rule: Bet the side when the model's expected home margin differs from the reference line by at least 3.0 points.
parameters: threshold = 3.0 pts (fixed before any result was seen)

rule: Bet over/under when the model total differs from the reference total by at least 3.0 points.
Bet the moneyline when the model's home win probability differs from the de-vigged market probability by at least 5 percentage points.
Back the home team when it is getting 2.5 points or more.
Back the team with at least three more days of rest than its opponent.
Back the home team in a divisional game when it is not favoured.
Back the away team when the home side is favoured by 10 or more.
When the side and total models both fire on the same game, combine the two legs into a two-leg parlay.
parameters: both S1 and S2 thresholds met; legs priced independently at -110
